note: Driving for Doors look book source. One entry per capture. Tags are derived from the production filename + DFD-POST-LOG.md. New captures append to the END of doors[]; the gallery renders newest-first by reversing.

doors.neighborhood: Lake Pleasant Pkwy & Happy Valley Rd
doors.alt: Almond carriage house garage door with arched glass, Peoria AZ
doors.caption: Amarr Classica 3000 carriage house in almond. Triple layer, 2in polyurethane, R-13.35, Tuscany panel with Seine arched glass and Blue Ridge decorative hardware.

doors.alt: Terracotta long panel steel garage door with tinted gray windows, Tortosa in Maricopa AZ
doors.caption: Clopay Classic Steel long panel in terracotta. Vinyl-backed insulated steel around R-7.0, with Tinted Gray glass set mid-row instead of the usual top row.

doors.alt: Quaker bronze full view aluminum garage door with frost glass, Fountain Hills AZ
doors.caption: Amarr Vista 1000 full view aluminum in Quaker Bronze with Frost glass. ClearView aluminum strut system and WaterLok joint sealing.

doors.alt: Black modern flush panel garage door with satin glass, Scottsdale AZ
doors.caption: Midland ThermoGuard flush panel in black with stacked long-panel Satin glass. 12in radius track, R-18 insulation. Installed by Swiftly with a LiftMaster 6580L Plus Series belt drive, battery backup, myQ, and 360 camera.

doors.alt: Black steel garage door with reeded glass windows, Sunnyslope Phoenix AZ
doors.caption: Amarr Lincoln 3138 in black with custom stacked reeded glass matched to the homeowner's front door. Steel-backed insulated 1-3/8in door, 15in radius track, High Cycle 50,000-cycle springs. Installed by Swiftly, re-hooked to the homeowner's existing LiftMaster opener.

doors.alt: Walnut wood-grain carriage house garage door, Avondale AZ
doors.caption: DoorLink 3630 grooved panel in a walnut wood-grain finish. 2in insulated steel sandwich panel, R-10.25, with spade-style strap hardware and matching pull handles.

doors.alt: Custom blue-gray carriage house garage door with crossbuck overlay, Arcadia AZ
doors.caption: Clopay Canyon Ridge Collection (our best read on this one), Ultra-Grain Cypress finish in a custom Color Blast blue-gray with a crossbuck overlay and square-pane glass. Steel and Intellicore polyurethane insulated construction.

doors.alt: White narrow recessed panel garage door with obscure glass windows, Gilbert AZ
doors.caption: Clopay Bridgeport Steel, Model BD5NV, Narrow Recessed Panel in white with a four-lite row of Obscure glass. 2-layer construction, vinyl-backed polystyrene insulation, R-6.3, 25 gauge steel.

doors.alt: Western cedar wood-grain garage door with arched glass windows, Tempe AZ
doors.caption: Wayne Dalton Classic Steel Model 8300/8300AG, Wood Grain Impressions finish in Western Cedar. Cascade Long arched window row over Vertical Long Panel bead-board bands, Spear decorative hardware kit, all Obscure glass. 3-layer steel/insulation/steel construction, R-12.12.
